Heartfelt Thanks for your Exceptional Care.

I'm writing to express our deepest gratitude for the incredible care you provided throughout my wife’s pregnancy and delivery of our baby.

From our very first appointment, your knowledge and calm demeanor gave us immense confidence. We truly appreciated your patience in explaining everything and ensuring we felt safe and informed at every step.

You are not just an outstanding doctor, but a truly compassionate individual. Knowing we were in your competent and caring hands brought us such peace of mind. You helped make one of the most significant moments of our life beautiful and positive, and for that, we are eternally grateful.

Thank you for your expertise, your kindness, and for delivering the most precious gift into our arms. You'll always hold a special place in our hearts.

With love and deepest appreciation,
The Picardo Family & little baby Jania ❤️🙏

P.s For expats to be new parents living in Phuket, look no further. You will not be disappointed. Highly recommended.

The doctor speaks English very well, which made communication smooth and stress-free. The nurse was very kind and accompanied me throughout the entire visit, making me feel comfortable and supported. The ultrasound was done very gently and professionally. I really appreciated the care and attention during the whole process.

He’s such a polite, sweet and a gentle doctor. Addressed all our queries. We went as walk-in. You may have to wait as there clinic is bustling with patients. But the ambience of this cute clinic with pastel walls and everything pretty around it is worth the wait.

Moreover when you see the doctor, his calm nature will put you at ease instantly. Highly recommend this place for anyone :)

I’m very grateful and satisfied with the way I was treated in this clinic, both by the nurse and the doctor. I went in with a very sensitive problem, being scared and very sad; and they were empathic and attentive.
The doctor is a professional, has a good English level; the clinic is small, but very clean and well organized.
The doctor went above and beyond to help me, as it turned up that I needed urgent surgery he arranged it for me at the hospital and come to perform it himself (this way it was less scary and complicated).
It’s almost a month since all of the above and  I moved in another zone. Therefore I went in Bangkok for a check up, everything healed great and I got another confirmation that the doctor did a great job.
I totally recommend this private practice.
The doctor was very gentle, and the nurses were kind

I visited the clinic for a standard STD checkup.
For 4,900 baht, the following procedures were performed: a gynecological examination, ultrasound, and swab tests. Blood tests (HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis) were not performed.

It's important to clarify in advance: at this clinic, a standard STD checkup does not include blood tests. These require a separate visit and additional payment, or referral to a third-party lab (which is what I was later advised to do).

Also, the quoted price for the services changed several times during the process, and additional paid procedures were actively offered.

I am writing this review for informational purposes—so that patients understand in advance what is and is not included in the service.
